title: Oven Roasted Mexican Lentils Chilaquiles
description: A tangy and dense Mexican dish featuring French lentils, perfect for an adventurous meal, this recipe is also Buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any animal products.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the French lentils, shio-koji, onion, and garlic.
Spread the lentil mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the lentils are roasting, heat the diced tomatoes and vegetable broth in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the roasted lentil mixture to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the tortilla chips to the saucepan and stir until they are well coated with the lentil mixture.
Season with chili powder and salt to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in the oven for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and stir in the lime juice.
